text: Poirot remained lost in thought for a few minutes. Finally he turned to the lawyer again. Wells, there is one thing I should like to ask you—that is, if it is not against professional etiquette. In the event of Mrs. Inglethorp’s death, who would inherit her money?” The lawyer hesitated a moment, and then replied: “The knowledge will be public property very soon, so if Mr. Cavendish does not object——” “Not at all,” interpolated John. “I do not see any reason why I should not answer your question.
